title: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program contains a vulnerable endpoint that allows an…
description: The U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program had a vulnerable endpoint that allowed unauthenticated attackers to create new user accounts by sending a POST request without requiring a cookie header. This vulnerability was fixed on or around October 19, 2026. The flaw allowed unauthorized privilege escalation but did not impact confidentiality or availability.
